evidence.title: HCL Tech stock crashes over 10% after Q4 miss, weak FY27 guidance; brokerages cut target prices (Moneycontrol, Apr 2026)
Infosys shares plummet 7% after Q4 results; what did analysts say? (Upstox)
Infosys shares end 7% lower after Q4 results in worst week since 2020 (CNBC TV18)

notes: HCL >10% confirmed; Infosys single-day fall was ~7% (claim said 6.5% - minor rounding). '12% over 3 sessions' and IT index ~4% are consistent with coverage but not explicitly confirmed. TradingView republished the Moneycontrol headline (same text).

corrected_claim: Amazon fell about 13% (closing -12.8%) on October 28, 2022 after weak Q3 results and soft fourth-quarter guidance - not 16-17%. US indices did close sharply higher that day (Dow +2.6%, its best day of 2022).

evidence.title: Amazon stock sinks 13% on weak fourth-quarter guidance (CNBC, Oct 2022)
Dow gains more than 500 points in best day of 2022 to wrap up wild week (CNBC, Oct 28 2022)

notes: 16-17% was the intraday-low exaggeration circulating on social media; closing move was ~13%.

evidence.title: Sensex, Nifty End 8th Consecutive Session Lower in Narrow Range (News On AIR)
Nifty 50 falls for 7th straight session, longest losing streak since Sept 2025 (Livemint)

notes: 8 consecutive down sessions ending ~29-30 Sep 2025 confirmed. The comparative claim ('second such streak in ~5 years; Feb 2025 tariff shock had 8') is not independently confirmed by these sources.

corrected_claim: Facebook/Meta's ~20%+ one-day crash happened on 3 February 2022 (first-ever decline in daily active users), not by 3 December 2021. In early December 2021 the FAANG/tech complex was roughly 10% below its November 2021 highs (Nasdaq Composite ended more than 10% below its record high; tech stocks fell as Omicron weighed), but Facebook declined only ~10-15% from its September 2021 peak by early December 2021, not ~20%.

evidence.title: Meta shares sink 20% as Facebook loses daily users for the first time (FashionNetwork / The Guardian, Feb 3 2022)
LIVE MARKETS: Nasdaq Composite ends down more than 10% from record high (Reuters)
Markets End Downbeat Week as Tech Stocks Fall, Omicron Weighs On Markets (WSJ, Dec 2021)

notes: The claim conflates the Feb-2022 Meta crash with the milder Dec-2021 tech pullback. 'Nearly 20% in two months by 3 Dec 2021' is not supported; 'FAANG down ~10%' is in the right ballpark vs Nov 2021 peaks.

corrected_claim: Microsoft fell about 10% (not 12%) after its quarterly results in late January 2026, erasing roughly $357 billion in market value - a historic post-earnings plunge - then was roughly flat the next day. Nasdaq-100 intraday swings of -800/+400 points were not confirmed at that precision.

evidence.title: Microsoft stock is flat the day after sinking 10%. Here's why (CNBC)
Microsoft's historic plunge: Why the company lost $357 billion in value despite strong results (GeekWire)
Stocks slip as Microsoft drags, oil jumps on Iran attack worry (Reuters)

notes: ~10% drop (CNBC) is authoritative; $357B value loss consistent with ~10% on a ~$3.5T market cap. Nasdaq-100 point swings unverified.

corrected_claim: Gold crashed about 8% in a day from record highs in late January 2026 (silver about 11%) as the rally reversed; gold/silver ETFs fell as much as ~24% cumulatively from record highs. That is severe but not '30% within 24 hours'; the repeated daily swings were roughly 4-8% for gold.

evidence.title: Gold price crashes 8%, silver 11% from record high as rally reverses sharply (Livemint)
Gold, silver ETFs crash up to 24% as precious metals tumble further from record highs (TradingView)
Gold price plunges 4% after rallying to record highs; silver drops 6% (Economic Times)

notes: Direction and severity confirmed; the '30% within 24 hours' magnitude is overstated. Cumulative ETF decline ~24% from record highs is the closest figure to the claim.

corrected_claim: Nvidia rose about 9-10% on 23 May 2024 after its blowout Q1 FY2025 results (closing about +9.3%; briefly above +10% intraday), not a clean '>10%' close. The broader market fell modestly that day (S&P 500 -0.74%, Nasdaq composite -0.4%, about 65 points) - not a ~400-point Nasdaq-100 intraday drop.

evidence.title: Nvidia shares close at record high after forecast signals unwavering demand for AI chips (CNBC, May 2024)
Stocks fall despite Nvidia boost as inflation concerns weigh (Reuters, 23 May 2024)
Nvidia adds over $200 billion in market value in post-earnings rally (Reuters)

notes: NVDA closed +9.3% on 23 May 2024 at $1,037.99. The ~400-point Nasdaq-100 drop is materially wrong - indices fell less than 1%.

corrected_claim: LIC IPO price band was Rs 902-949 per share (not 900-950). The anchor book was fully subscribed: about 59 million shares were reserved, and LIC raised Rs 5,627 crore from anchor investors, with domestic mutual funds taking ~71% of the anchor portion (Singapore's GIC and Norway's Norges Bank were among the foreign anchor investors reported in contemporaneous coverage).

evidence.title: Over 59 mln shares reserved for anchor investors in LIC IPO (Reuters)
LIC raises Rs 5,627 crore from anchor investors led by domestic institutions (The Hindu)
Domestic mutual funds pick up 71% of LIC IPO's anchor portion (Times of India)

notes: Band corrected to Rs 902-949. Anchor subscription confirmed. GIC/Norges participation is from contemporaneous reporting but not in these specific headlines - low risk.

evidence.title: India central bank raises key rate 50 basis points (Reuters, 5 Aug 2022)
Loan EMIs to go up after RBI hikes rates by 50 basis points to 5.4% (Times of India)
Rupee gains 46 paise to 78.94 against US dollar ahead of RBI policy outcome (Indian Express, 5 Aug 2022)

notes: 50bps to 5.40% confirmed. Rupee gained ~46 paise (claim said ~50 - within rounding). 'More than the 35-40bps expected': consensus clustered 35-50bps, so 50 was at the high end - fair characterization.

evidence.title: Retail inflation based on CPI slips to 6.83% in August 2023 (News On AIR, 12 Sep 2023)
Beating All Expectations, India's Retail Inflation Declines To 6.83 Percent In August (India.com)

notes: August 2023 CPI = 6.83% (released 12 Sep 2023): below 7%, above RBI's 6% tolerance band. Confirmed.
